text:
maria: Hey team — a quick one while Im on parental leave: my return date is July 12 and Im planning a 60% phased return for 6 weeks. Two questions: 1) how does this affect my performance review cycle and eligibility for the discretionary bonus? 2) we started hiring a short-term IC to cover my role will the hire be converted or is it strictly a contractor backfill? Want to align expectations before Im back.

sara-people-ops: Hi Maria, congrats again! :sparkles: Short answers: 1) Performance reviews are based on the review period we document your leave and phased schedule; your manager can provide an outcomes-based assessment. Bonus eligibility depends on time-in-role and prorated targets. 2) Hiring decisions are with your manager + recruiting; People Ops coordinates title/comp approval if conversion is considered.

josh-manager: @maria thanks for the heads up. My plan is to run the review on the normal cadence but factor in the leave window. If youre doing a 60% ramp Ill use the goals you completed and split the remaining goals as "in progress" for the next cycle. Bonus: we normally prorate based on time on payroll during the bonus period.

ben-payroll: For bonus proration we need the exact payroll status dates. If youre on LOA and not on payroll for part of the period, bonus is prorated accordingly. If you remain on payroll and receive parental pay, youre eligible for full bonus. Please confirm LOA payment status with People Ops.

maria: I was on statutory leave pay for 4 weeks then unpaid LOA. Ill upload docs if thats needed.

linda-peopleops: Thanks @maria. Please upload the LOA payment summary to the HR portal so payroll can calculate proration. Also file the phased return form (HR Portal > Leaves > Phased Return). Ive pasted the minimal info we need:```- planned start date (7/12) - % of FTE each week for 6 weeks - on-call availability windows - equipment needs and office days```

recruiting-bot: Candidate update: contractor "DevIC-345" expected start 6/8 for 3 months. Manager can request conversion by submitting Recruiting -> Conversion Request form before week 9 of the contract. Note: conversions require a manager sign-off and headcount check.

josh-manager: My intent is to have the contractor cover core delivery until youre back and then well reassess. If performance is strong Id like to propose a 6-month extension rather than immediate conversion. @maria does that work for you?

maria: Thats fine. Id appreciate a clear handoff plan and any overlap time to onboard them. I can do 2 half-days the week before full return to shadow.

eng-ops: FYI if youre doing remote-phased return and need office access we need your badge reactivated. Submit an office access request 5 business days before your first in-office day. For equipment: if you need a second laptop for split working we need procurement approval.

tomo-hrlegal: Quick legal note: if the contractor will have access to sensitive customer data, well need an NDA + data access attestation before start. Also if theres a plan to convert, remind your manager to run the local hiring eligibility check (headcount + budget).

sara-people-ops: Summarizing action items:```- @maria: upload LOA pay summary + submit phased return form- @josh-manager: confirm contractor scope and decide conversion timeline- @ben-payroll & People Ops: calculate bonus proration after docs- @eng-ops: badge/equipment request for phased return- @recruiting-bot: share contractor onboarding checklist```

maria: great checklist Ill upload docs today and set the shadow half-days. Thanks everyone!
